The lawlessness that we saw last week in New Jersey continues to prove that Democrats are more focused on putting illegal aliens ahead of the safety and security of the American people. 

I remain focused on fully funding DHS and giving our ICE officers the resources they need to keep our communities safe.


Homeland Security (@DHSgov)

If you riot, you will be ARRESTED.

Last night, our New Jersey law enforcement partners took action to arrest rioters. 

Lawlessness will NOT be tolerated.

Vide

It was an honor to speak with Alabama Girls State delegates at the 2026 opening ceremony.

This organization means the world to me as a former Enterprise High School delegate and Girls State Governor. It’s why, now five years ago, I announced my Senate campaign at this event. 

I know this week ahead will be as impactful for this group of young women as it was for me, and I can’t wait to see the ways they will lead and serve in the future.

Birmingham-Southern College has shaped leaders for generations, and soon it will help train the men and women of the Coast Guard who serve and protect our nation.

I’m proud to have fought for this opportunity, and I’m even more excited about what it means for Birmingham, the Coast Guard, and our nation’s future. Read more below ⬇️ al.com/news/birmingham/2026/…
National Champs! Congratulations to the Northeast Alabama Mustangs on winning their first national title. What an incredible season! waff.com/2026/05/31/northeas…

Great to see Huntsville showing @SteveDoocy some Alabama hospitality! 

The Rocket City continues to prove why it’s one of the fastest-growing cities in our nation and why Alabama is the best place to call home. foxnews.com/video/6396776986…

Alabamians: The App for Trump Accounts is live! You can enroll and set up an account for your children. I am proud to work with @USTreasury to ensure more hardworking Americans will have the opportunity to invest, track their investments, and even improve their financial literacy.

Download it now from the App Store! al.com/news/2026/05/trump-ac…

Thank you @SecRollins for putting American cotton first. Producers in Alabama and across the Southeast rely on strong markets and regulatory certainty, and this plan delivers. 

In the Senate, I will continue championing the Buying American Cotton Act to provide stability for our producers at home. I’m proud to support those who grow our high-quality, Made in America cotton.


Secretary Brooke Rollins (@SecRollins)

The Great American Cotton Plan is about one thing: Putting American cotton first

Happy Birthday to the man who does it all, @SecRubio!


Margo Martin (@MargoMartin47)

Happy Birthday, @SecRubio! 🤣🇺🇸

Video

Thrilled to see the launch of the Trump Accounts app. When accounts officially open on July 4, Alabama families will be able to watch their investments grow and see the benefits of participating in our financial markets in real time.

If you haven’t enrolled, head to TrumpAccounts.gov today to learn more about this incredible initiative to build a financial foundation for our next generation.



Treasury Department (@USTreasury)

I know firsthand how quickly severe weather can turn dangerous in Alabama.

Whether it’s tornadoes, flooding, or severe storms, having a plan for your family, emergency supplies ready, and staying up to date on weather alerts can make all the difference.

Proud to lead the Mandatory E-Verify Act and grateful to @SenHydeSmith for joining this effort.

It’s time to make E-Verify mandatory nationwide, enforce the law, and protect American jobs.


U.S. Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith (@SenHydeSmith)

E-Verify works, but lax enforcement and open-border policies have undermined its effectiveness. I’m proud to cosponsor @SenKatieBritt's Mandatory E-Verify Act to permanently reauthorize E-Verify and require its use nationwide to guarantee that authorized worker

For far too long, waste, fraud, and abuse ran rampant in our government, all at the expense of the American taxpayer. 

Thank you @VP Vance and @POTUS for leading this charge to crack down on fraud and work to restore transparency and accountability to federal programs.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

As we reflect this Memorial Day, please join me in honoring the three Alabamians, Major Alex Klinner, Major Ariana G. Savino, and Technical Sargent Ashley B. Pruitt, who lost their lives this March.

All of Alabama, and our entire country, remember them today for their bravery and for making the ultimate sacrifice. We hold their families in prayer today. They will never be forgotten. britt.senate.gov/news/press-…

I am proud to have secured the necessary $41.2 million to finish the advanced individual training barracks at Fort Rucker in the FY2024 Military Construction and Veterans Affairs Appropriations bill. 

I’m deeply committed to improving soldiers’ quality of life, and I’m excited the project is nearing completion.


1819 News (@1819News)

Fort Rucker barracks undergoing transformation
By @EricaTNews 
1819news.com/news/item/fort-…

This Memorial Day, we remember and honor the courageous men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country.

Their service secured the freedoms we cherish, and their legacy will never be forgotten. May we live each day worthy of their service and sacrifice.
